# Machines & Cloud

> Machines & Cloud builds an AI front desk for Houston home service companies (HVAC, plumbing, electrical, roofing): a front desk that answers calls, texts, website chats, and Thumbtack or Angi leads within a minute, books the visit, and texts the owner the lead, with human handoff for anything risky. Free 7 day pilot, then $397 per month plus a one-time $1,497 build. Phone answering is a $297 per month add-on with 300 call minutes included, then $0.35 a minute. Lead follow-up and review requests (instant text-back to Angi, Thumbtack, and website leads; after-job review request) is a $197 per month add-on with 500 texts included. Founder led, Houston based.
